corpus.text: Python lists are ordered and mutable. Elements can be replaced after creation. Lists allow duplicate values.
Python tuples are ordered and immutable. Tuple elements cannot be reassigned after creation.
A Python dictionary maps unique hashable keys to values. Dictionary lookup uses the key.
Python sets contain unique elements. Creating a set from repeated values removes duplicates.
An asyncio coroutine can suspend at await so other scheduled work can progress. Await does not create a new operating system thread.
Blocking CPU work inside an asyncio event loop can delay other coroutines. Offload suitable work or split it into smaller pieces.
A JavaScript promise represents an eventual fulfilled value or rejection. An async function always returns a promise.
The promise executor runs synchronously when constructed. then, catch, and finally handlers execute asynchronously.
Promise.all fulfills when all inputs fulfill. It rejects when one input rejects and does not automatically cancel other operations.
Promise.allSettled reports the outcome of every input promise regardless of fulfillment or rejection.
Browser synchronous code runs before promise microtasks. Eligible timer callbacks run as later tasks.
Returning a promise from a then callback makes the next promise adopt its eventual state. Throwing in a callback rejects the next promise.
A PostgreSQL transaction groups changes. A rollback cancels uncommitted changes, while commit makes them durable.
A foreign key links a row to a referenced row and enforces referential integrity.
A unique constraint prevents duplicate values in its constrained columns.
A database index can speed up lookup but adds storage and maintenance work during writes.
